data-centric approaches for modeling driver behavior are useful for predicting driver behavior, detecting risky driver behavior, and detecting driver frustration.

modeling the behavior of drivers in a variety and range of traffic conditions using large amounts of on-road driving data.

the following three aspects of driver behavior modeling: (a) statistical modeling of driver pedal-operation behavior, (b) statistical modeling of car-following behavior, and (c) statistical modeling of lane-change behavior.
the application of signal processing and machine learning to the modeling and analysis of driving data, with the ultimate goal of improving driver safety.
